title: "Tomonori Tanaka"
---

**Specially Appointed Assistant Professor**
Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Institute of Science Tokyo

---

I am a computational materials scientist working on first-principles methods for magnetic materials. My research focuses on finite-temperature magnetism, phonon properties, and phase equilibria of functional materials including permanent magnets.

**Research keywords:** first-principles calculation · finite-temperature magnetism · permanent magnets · phonon · phase equilibrium
